bossRules.humanPattern: One piercing command; remaining actions use distributed single targets.
bossRules.monsterPattern: One area attack; remaining actions use distributed single targets.
bossRules.tutorial: Stage 1-2 is not a boss and keeps its single forecast.

regressions: Public Illusion previews and API-shaped JSON summaries report Close, zero predicted attacks and no damage/action-only consumption. Ten consecutive reads preserve the complete battle state and consume no RNG. Real Illusion resolution still consumes its offered card without damage or flame rolls.
Extra forecasts have unique round/enemy/part/occurrence identities.
All repeated actions from a broken weapon cancel while the core actions remain valid.
Both destroyed parts leave only one body fallback; restart restores every boss part and the initial action count.
Interception of an extra core action retains the original recipient and reusable exact part/occurrence identity.
Four-person guard-only HTTP rounds reveal exactly four, five and six intact boss forecasts.
Sanity, flames, two consecutive clash wins, one attack after victory, physical damage events and rewards retain their existing rules.
New hands, fixed party action positions, boss backline one-action cap, stage gates and after-story rewards remain covered.

illusionPreviewCorrection.verification: Core full suite rerun only, now 69 tests. One new regression covers direct/assigned public Preview, API-shaped JSON serialization, complete battle-state equality after ten reads, zero RNG calls and the unchanged actual no-damage/no-roll resolution.
illusionPreviewCorrection.campaignAndHttpRerun: Not repeated for this presentation-query correction; the previously recorded 75 campaign runs and isolated HTTP checks remain applicable to the unchanged battle resolver.

balanceObservation.interpretation: The change expands the number of threats and interception choices. It does not demonstrate a large difficulty increase under recommended play: winning more clashes also supplies attack opportunities and existing resource gains. No HP, power, reward or clash-economy adjustment was made.
